Summary
: The English translation of the Jarasandhavadha Mahakavyam: a Sanskrit epic poem written by Goswami Hariraiji. The story revolves around the story of Krishna’s vanquishing of the Magadha King, Jarasandha. The soul message of this epic Jarasandhavadha is “where there is righteousness there is victory”.
The sources for this story include the Mahabharata, the Puranas, the Harivamsha Purana and the Bhagavata Purana.
